# Transactional cohort analysis and basket metric aggregation
def analyze_retail_cohorts(df: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
    df['transaction_date'] = pd.to_datetime(df['date'])
    cohort_summary = df.groupby(['hub_region', 'product_category']).agg(
        total_gmv=('amount', 'sum'),
        active_buyers=('customer_id', 'nunique'),
        avg_basket_size=('quantity', 'mean')
    ).reset_index()
    cohort_summary['growth_pct'] = cohort_summary['total_gmv'].pct_change() * 100
    return cohort_summary
